# Summary and questions
This post is to review the examples of effective Hamiltonian.

# Examples of dresssed Rydberg interactions

In Rydberg experiment, atom encoded in the $\ket{0}-\ket{1}$ states do not have interactions while the encoding $\ket{1}-\ket{r}$ are hard to implement the $H$ gates. We consider the possibility to dress the $\ket{1}$ with $\ket{r}$ to introduce an interaction on the  $\ket{0},\ket{1}$ encoding.
